_readme: Answer keys for the two 2022 חלק ב' (דין דיוני) sittings, TRANSCRIBED BY HAND.
WHY BY HAND. Unlike every other key in this bank, these two PDFs carry no text
layer — each page is a single scanned image — and no OCR is installed. The
pages were rendered with PyMuPDF and read; the answer-letter column was then
cropped and read a second time, independently, and both readings agreed on all
80 rows. The citations come from the full-page reading only.
SOURCE PDFs (in the exam bank, alongside the papers):
VERSIONS. Each key covers two versions of the paper, mirror-numbered: question
N in version 1 is question 41-N in version 2. The numbers below are VERSION 1,
the column the key prints first and in ascending order, and the version the
question PDFs in מאגר דיוני בלבד hold — confirmed against the questions
themselves (see the check printed by build-2022.py).
